newsitem.title: HUNGARY: IBM HUNGARY TO FLY PARTS TO U.S. FROM 1998.
newsitem.headline: IBM HUNGARY TO FLY PARTS TO U.S. FROM 1998.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp (IBM) plans to send roughly 2,000 tonnes a year of computer and electronic parts from its Hungarian plants by air to the United States, with shipments starting by 1998, air cargo industry sources in Budapest said.
IBM is expected before September to name a freight forwarder to handle the shipments, but it was not clear when this year the deliveries would start, the sources said.
IBM already sends roughly 4,000 tonnes a year of parts and raw material by air from the Far East to major airports in western Europe for delivery by truck into Hungary, the sources said.
